acceptedProperties: A product Turn runtime actor is derived from the complete immutable scope, Turn, dispatch and generation identity.
The runtime persists message digest and execution reservation before its first external execution await.
A lost start response persists unknown; reopen and observe can recover terminal state without another start.
Repeated accept with the same payload observes the existing runtime, while a changed message or identity fails closed.
Only the first cancel request crosses the external cancel boundary; repeated cancellation observes the same runtime.
Execution terminal state is durable before checkpoint commit, and an uncertain checkpoint is reconciled by immutable observe before it becomes a persistence error.
Running and terminal events are retained by event ID; conflicting reuse is rejected.
Canonical hierarchical R2 object keys pass through Runtime, Dispatcher and Journal with one shared validator.
